§ 01 · The Program

Real impact,
real decisions.

From reducing a carbon footprint and handling a greenwashing accusation, to building ethical supply chains, engaging communities, and presenting ESG results to the board, every scenario drops you into a genuine sustainability situation and asks one question: what should you actually do? Forty-two foundations-focused scenarios and fifty-eight strategy-and-governance-focused scenarios, covered systematically, one real decision at a time.

01

Built for real sustainability judgment

Every scenario mirrors an actual situation a sustainability or ESG professional faces — never abstract, never artificial.

02

Systematic, complete coverage

A full set of 100 scenarios across climate, ESG governance, ethical supply chains, community impact, and reporting.

03

Auto-graded

Instant scoring with clear, encouraging feedback after every exercise.

04

Genuine decision-making practice

Real situations with one best-practice response and three realistic missteps — not vocabulary drills, but sound sustainability judgment under real pressure.

§ 02 · 100 Scenarios

Choose your
scenario.

Every scenario contains 10 decision-making questions, a focused introduction, key sustainability and ESG terms to learn, and a practical tip. Search, filter by Foundations or Scale, and go at your own pace.

§ 03 · The Author

Brice Gadou

Business English & Sustainability Coach

Brice Gadou is a business English specialist dedicated to helping sustainability and ESG professionals think clearly under pressure in a second language. Mr. Gad reflects his belief that real fluency in sustainability isn't reciting phrases — it's reading a situation correctly and choosing the right response, in the moment.

Designed for B1–C1 learners who already work in, or aspire to work in, sustainability and ESG roles in English — Mr. Gad Sustainability & Corporate Responsibility is more than a language course. It's a working rehearsal for the sustainability moments you'll actually face.
